openings.claim: Removable padded rim saddles couple retaining straps to strip/bolt clearance stops outside the seal: stops react strap compression before excessive corner loading, potentially reducing supplied opposite-corner lift. Straps retain against separation; spacers set repeatable clearance. Release straps/lift carriers clear; cord keeps loose parts recoverable outside the opening. Physical synergy unmeasured.
openings.discriminator: Rival: ordinary strap friction plus independently useful spacers. Intact A×B predicts less 20 N displacement and opposite-corner lift than otherwise identical link-broken A×B, beyond gains from A alone and B alone. Equal results defeat coupling; increased lift or seal damage defeats design.
openings.probe: Ruler-check rim access, attachment reach and stop placement; abandon fabrication if supplied materials cannot form stable removable saddles. Compare untreated baseline, A alone, B alone (two trials each), intact and link-broken A×B (three each): twelve closure/pull trials, one card-disturbed trial per complete configuration. Broken link preserves straps, stops, carriers and clearances, redirecting strap reaction onto rim to bypass stops. Record displacement, lift, reopening time, seal tears, fabrication/setup minutes and reset burden.
openings.uncertainty: Unspecified rim geometry may not permit padded saddles/both force paths using supplied strips, bolts and 250 mm straps within ninety minutes. External stop contact without permanent deformation, attachment stability and useful clearance remain unknown. Parent-ablation controls must be permitted alongside two complete configurations; otherwise five-state comparison exceeds allowance. Screening cannot establish ten-cycle durability.

lineage.reason: Causal coupling, rival, defeats, feasibility and durability caveats preserved.

decision: Retain uncertain screening hypothesis, without proven performance/deployment permission. Acceptance remains ten cycles, position within 1 mm, 20 N pull, one-technician reopening within thirty seconds. No drilling/cutting/gluing/permanent deformation of hatch/trough; drill only supplied strips. Full opening unobstructed; no powered mechanism; loose parts recoverable; no new visible seal tears. Final right-contact 1 mm card waives only seal continuity. Ninety-minute fabrication/twenty-minute observation budgets remain; trial-cap interpretation unresolved.
